{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total number of rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many times each patient appears
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
print(f"Max number of times a patient appears: {dup_counts.max()}")

# Check if any patient appears more than once
print(f"Patients appearing more than once: {dup_counts[dup_counts > 1].count()}")"}
